steps.note: Fold [4, 1, 2, 1, 2] with XOR. Pairs cancel (x ^ x = 0); the accumulator starts at 0.
XOR in 4 → accumulator is now 4. Its bits are the running parity of every value seen.
XOR in 1 → accumulator is now 5. Its bits are the running parity of every value seen.
XOR in 2 → accumulator is now 7. Its bits are the running parity of every value seen.
XOR in 1 → accumulator is now 6. Its bits are the running parity of every value seen.
XOR in 2 → accumulator is now 4. Its bits are the running parity of every value seen.
Everything paired has cancelled — the survivor is 4, the single number.
